nodes.label: Visit Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Structured state machine from PENDING to terminal states (RENTAL_FINALIZED, REJECTED, CLOSED) with mandatory side effects on every transition.

nodes.label: Location Unlock Rule
nodes.rationale: Exact address revealed only when visit.location_unlocked is true AND status is ACCEPTED or beyond, and only to that specific tenant.

nodes.label: Post-Visit Follow-up System
nodes.rationale: System triggers follow-up 2h after visit time, asks 4-response question to each party, auto-archives after 5 days of no response.

nodes.label: Onboarding Steps
nodes.rationale: Fixed 3-step sequence: Role Selection -> Profile Setup -> KYC (mandatory landlord, skippable tenant). Steps cannot be reordered.

nodes.label: KYC Mandatory For Landlord
nodes.rationale: Landlord must complete Citizenship or National ID verification before publishing any listing; tenants can defer.

nodes.label: Address Privacy Rule
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable product principle: exact address and precise GPS pin never shown to any tenant until that tenant's specific visit is ACCEPTED.

nodes.label: Broker Elimination
nodes.rationale: The platform is a direct replacement for the Nepali broker (dalal) — not a tool to help brokers work. Zero commission is the explicit economic claim.

nodes.label: Phone Number As Identity
nodes.rationale: Authentication is +977 phone OTP only. No email, social login, or password exists. Phone number is the permanent user identity.

nodes.label: Dual Role System
nodes.rationale: A single account can hold both Tenant and Landlord roles; role is switched instantly from Profile and the home/dock adapt.

nodes.label: Verification Builds Trust
nodes.rationale: Landlord identity verification is mandatory and cannot be bypassed; tenant verification is optional but grants a visible trust badge.

nodes.label: Pro Plan (Tenant Only)
nodes.rationale: Paid tenant plan unlocking exactly 5 features: 24h early access, AI preference config, priority requests, unlimited requests, Pro badge.

nodes.label: Property Status System
nodes.rationale: Four real-time public statuses on every listing: AVAILABLE, HIGH_DEMAND, UNDER_DISCUSSION, OCCUPIED.

nodes.label: Real-Time Notification System
nodes.rationale: 13 notification types grouped by date, color-coded, and deep-linked to the relevant screen.

links.notes: Layout composes all step elements (headline, illustration, dots, next/skip) for one onboarding step.
OnboardingLayout uses PaginationDots for current step; StepProgressBar represents the same step progress visually.
Both render the user's progress through the 3-step onboarding, but StepProgressBar is a bar with percentages and PaginationDots is a dot row.
Visualizes the 3-step onboarding: 'Step 1 of 3' through 'Step 3 of 3'.
Paints the literal 'VERIFIED' badge that the trust principle is meant to produce.
Illustration depicts a VERIFIED badge — the visual artifact of KYCStatus=VERIFIED.
Illustration depicts a visit booking card with date/slot selection.
Depicts the scheduling step that precedes the post-visit follow-up trigger.
Renders a Confirmed visit — one of the lifecycle states in the visit status machine.
Routes to (tenant) or (landlord) tabs — codifies the dual-role system at startup.
Store carries the OnboardingKYCData (documentType, front/back images, electricity bill) — the KYC payload mandated for landlords.
kyc.documentType is one of the values tracked in KYCStatus state machine (UNVERIFIED/UNDER_REVIEW/VERIFIED/REJECTED).
The store's shape (roles -> profile -> kyc) mirrors the 3-step onboarding sequence 1:1.
